worldcombat.skill.conversion.summary: Reads the type of the first move in the moveset and temporarily reweaves the body into that type.
worldcombat.skill.conversion.use.1: Reweave the body into that type
worldcombat.skill.conversion.description: Scans its own moveset, then completes the reweave after %1$s; it does not fire when the body already has that type.
The new type lasts %1$s; type matchups, same-type bonus and type immunities settle on it while it holds.
Reweaving costs %1$s of cooldown; this pattern is %2$s light bands, growing with Special Attack.
